{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Cobalt Guard''', internally referred to as '''Guard Plush''', is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health and an average speed, though unlike the [[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] that appears before it, it has no defense. It is also a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy, meaning only towers with lead detection can damage it. It is also [[Stun Immunity|Stun Immune]], making it only get slowed down by stuns and immune to knockback. ==Appearance== The '''Cobalt Guard''' is a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It is entirely made of plush fabric shown by the stitches that can be seen throughout its body. It wears a dark purple crusader helmet, chestplate with white horns, leggings, belt, boots knee-pads and shoulder-pads as well as black braces with dark purple spikes. A pair of small white eyes in an angry expression can be seen in the eyeholes of the helmet. The '''Cobalt Guard''' has a death animation where it will fall to its knees before falling forward. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers with lead detection, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are quite effective against this. **The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give all your towers lead detection for a brief period of time. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be also used to boost the DPS of your towers. *The '''Cobalt Guard''' is quite fast, though due to its immunities it is harder to stall. **Its [[Stun Immunity]] prevents it from being knocked back and makes stuns only slow it down. **Other forms of stalling, such as the [[DJ Booth]]'s slowdown, are unaffected. **The [[Frost Blaster]] can freeze and deal good damage to them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} CobaltGuardWalk.gif|Walking animation (22 January - Present) CobaltGuardDeath.gif|Death animation (22 January - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1GuardPlush.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseCobaltGuard.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GuardPlushIconIG.png|'''Cobalt Guard''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Unlocking the '''Cobalt Guard's''' logbook will not grant you the ability to summon the [[Cobalt Guard (Solar Eclipse)|Cobalt Guard]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. **This is due to the '''Cobalt Guard's''' internal name being ''Guard Plush''. ==Update History== *'''22 January 2025''' -
